openmap-collect.config.page.title: GeoSurvey Cartographer
openmap-collect.option.collector.desc: Blank by default. Ground goes to this address only when contribute ground below is on.
openmap-collect.option.enabled.desc: Off by default; on, it posts surveyed chunks to the collector above, with the server, dimension and your Minecraft UUID. The collector keeps ground forever and offers no removal; a shared claim or marker sends your player name.
openmap-collect.option.claim_greetings.d: Off by default; on a known server, it reads that server's Dynmap web map, else Open-Map's node copy. With contribute ground on and the collector at avience.live, it posts learned greetings, the claim and your Minecraft UUID.
openmap-collect.option.servers.desc: Blank by default: contribute from every server. Server names, comma separated: contribute from those only; single-player worlds are never contributed.
openmap-collect.option.status.desc: Read at page open: the first setup step that stops ground reaching the collector, or what is under way. Show in Chat lists every step, as /geosurvey share does.
openmap-collect.status.no_address: no collector address; nothing is sent
openmap-collect.status.off: contributing is off; no ground is sent
openmap-collect.status.not_an_address: not an http:// or https:// address
openmap-collect.status.gate_all: contributing from every server except single-player worlds
openmap-collect.status.checking: Checking whether that address answers as a collector. Done stores it only after it answers.
openmap-collect.status.no_answer: That address does not answer as a collector. Done will not store it.
openmap-collect.status.cleartext: http, not on your network; readable on the way; Done will not store it; use https
openmap-collect.status.not_listed: this server is not on servers to contribute from; no ground is sent
openmap-collect.status.key_unproven: prove this account to the collector is off
openmap-collect.status.key_refused: the collector did not accept this computer's own key
openmap-collect.status.walk: uploads wait for a walk to the collector's regions
openmap-collect.status.refused: the collector refused an upload; /geosurvey share says why
openmap-collect.status.unreached: no upload reached the collector; /geosurvey share says why
openmap-collect.toast.approved_ports.tit: Approved servers match the port you typed
openmap-collect.toast.approved_ports.bod: An entry with a port approves only that host and port. An entry with no port, or port 25565, approves that host on any port.
openmap-collect.toast.dropped_servers.ti: Some approved servers were not added
openmap-collect.toast.save_failed.title: GeoSurvey Cartographer settings not saved
openmap-collect.toast.settings_unreadabl: GeoSurvey Cartographer settings could not be read
